hypothesis.method: Fine-tune a large multimodal foundation model with synthetic counterfactual data generated via structured world-model simulation
hypothesis.problem: Generative AI systems exhibit fragile generalization under semantically valid but causally novel inputs
hypothesis.goal: Achieve robust, interpretable generalization across unobserved causal dynamics in visual-language generation

messages.content: Propose one novel and scientifically valid research hypothesis in the field of artificial intelligence, in particular generative AI. Express it as three short phrases: a Method (the technique to be used), a Problem (the problem to be addressed), and a Goal (the property to be improved). Answer only with a JSON object of the form {"method": "...", "problem": "...", "goal": "..."} and nothing else.
